### Lakeland

- **Type:** City
- **Status:** 🟢 Active
- **Date enacted:** 2026-08-03, City Commission adopted Ordinance No. 26-018 by a 4-3 vote.
- **Normalized date:** `2026-08-03` (exact)
- **Duration:** One year from 2026-08-03, unless amended or repealed sooner. Covers new data centers and large-load customers with anticipated peak demand of 50 MW or more while the City reviews its planning and land-development rules.
- **Current end date:** `—`
- **Sectors:** data center
- **Moratorium ID:** `fl-lakeland-undated`
- **Legal basis:** City of Lakeland Ordinance No. 26-018, adopted 2026-08-03 by a 4-3 vote
- **What prompted it:** Followed community opposition to Project Swan, a proposed approximately 600,000-square-foot data center.
- **Affected projects:** Project Swan (proposed approximately 600,000 sq ft data center; Kimley-Horn on behalf of Ryan Companies U.S., Inc.)
- **Detailed status:** Active as of 2026-08-19. The City Commission adopted Ordinance No. 26-018 4-3 on 2026-08-03, pausing acceptance, processing, review, and approval of covered applications for one year.
- **Outcome:** Ordinance No. 26-018 is effective immediately and pauses new covered applications while the City considers permanent rules.

### Nassau County

- **Type:** County
- **Status:** 🟢 Active
- **Date enacted:** Adopted on final hearing 2026-06-08 by the Nassau County Board of County Commissioners (motion by Commissioner Gray, seconded by Commissioner Farmer, approved); first reading was 2026-05-11, following direction to draft on 2026-04-13.
- **Normalized date:** `2026-06-08` (exact)
- **Duration:** 12 months from the effective date, or until an ordinance amending the Comprehensive Plan, Land Development Regulations, and/or Code of Ordinances relating to Data Center Facilities takes effect, whichever occurs first (Ordinance 2026-044, Section 6). Effective date is upon filing with the Florida Secretary of State per s. 125.66.
- **Current end date:** `—`
- **Sectors:** data center, cryptocurrency mining
- **Moratorium ID:** `fl-nassau-county-2026`
- **Legal basis:** Nassau County Ordinance No. 2026-044, "Imposing a Temporary Moratorium on the Acceptance, Review, or Approval of Applications for Development Permits, Development Orders, Rezoning, or Site Plans Related to Data Centers, Data Processing Facilities, Data Mining or Cryptocurrency Mining Operations ... Within Unincorporated Nassau County, Florida."
- **What prompted it:** Board directed staff to draft the moratorium in April 2026 to allow time to study and adopt comprehensive-plan and land-development-code provisions for data centers before accepting further applications; a companion resolution (2026-102) created a Fact-Finding Committee on Data Center Development that met repeatedly through June 2026.
- **Affected projects:** No specific pending project named in the ordinance itself; adopted preemptively alongside the Fact-Finding Committee on Data Center Development.
- **Detailed status:** Active as of 2026-07-31. Checked the June 22, July 13, and July 27, 2026 BOCC agendas; no repeal, amendment, or extension item found. Applies only to unincorporated Nassau County.
- **Outcome:** Ordinance adopted on final hearing 2026-06-08; moratorium in effect for up to 12 months or until permanent Data Center Facility regulations are adopted, whichever is sooner.
